spans.text: ...On the other side of the battlefield.
The shore gun's mechanisms are running at full speed, and the clamor of the machinery even manages to drown out the sound of gunfire outside.
M4 frantically fiddles with the cannon's fire control systems, trying to figure out how to aim the cannon as quickly as possible.
Once the hacking is successful, she immediately attempts to establish communications with the Commander, but her only response from the channel is static.
Dandelion, do you copy?! What's the situation now?
Lunasia, the Commander is still alive, but we can no longer use the quarantine wall as a line of defense.
Griffin's situation is critical. Are you ready to fire?
Ready to fire anytime! How's the loading going?
15 seconds until it's done!
Does the Commander have a plan?
Griffin has taken grievous losses. They are now withdrawing to the sectors within the base which 404 have already explored.
They desperately need fire support from you.
Got it! We'll cover them as best as we can!
M4, loading complete!
Ready to fire! What are the coordinates?
I've already sent you the location of the train that DEFY found.
Received!
Commencing firing sequence!
The gigantic coastal defense artillery gun slowly adjusts its angle...
A thunderous cannon blast drowns out all other sound, and the mighty shockwave from the cannon's muzzle even knocks over some of the attacking soldiers.
The soldiers take advantage of the massive clouds of dust that have been thrown up to make a charge, but they are repelled by the defending AR Team again and again.
Quartz to Terra!
The enemy is firing the shore gun! Please withdraw immediately!
I repeat, please withdraw immediately!
What?!
The enemy's taken control of the coastal defense gun and they're firing at—
Before the officer can finish speaking, the shell fired by the coastal artillery impacts near the armored train.
The titanic impact of the shell rocks the armored train violently.
The shockwave throws Yegor against a wall, and the ammunition and documents on the table are scattered all over the floor.
Dammit!
Start the train up immediately! Our shields can't stop rounds of that size!
Right away, sir!
The first shot was off target. The Military trains are starting to move.
Correcting trajectory... You won't get away this time!
As the Military trains sluggishly heave themselves into motion, the second shell from the shore gun whistles past and scores a direct hit on the rearmost train.
The train continues forward on momentum, but soon a massive explosion erupts from within it. The main cannon is blasted high into the air and excavates a huge crater when it finally lands.
The train itself blazes ferociously, and burning soldiers struggle to free themselves in a frenzy.
Train 4 has been destroyed!
Tsk! Proceed at full speed toward the quarantine wall and smash that pile of Griffin trash aside! All units, hit them hard!
Destroy Griffin at all costs!
What's the situation now?
The second shot hit the armored train.
I saw it from here!
It's just like fireworks! Boom — to kingdom come!
We have enough rounds; we can keep shooting!
Alright, we'll continue supporting the Commander!
RO, are the enemy still trying to attack?
That's strange, the infantry attacks have tapered off...
I have a bad feeling about this...
Before long, the Dolls feel an explosion and shockwave above them.
Looks like they're thinking of destroying the cannon directly since they can't take it!
I suggest we get out of here ASAP; if the cannon comes crashing down, it might bring the whole place down along with it!
Hold on just a little longer!
Every shell we fire will ease the pressure on the Commander!
I agree, this shore gun seems very solid. I'm sure it'll last a while longer!
The Military is launching an all-out attack.
Their vanguard has made it past the quarantine wall and they are drawing closer to the remnants of Griffin's forces.
Adjust the cannon's firing angle, we need to buy the Commander more time to withdraw!
Ahhhh, what a pain! It's like a piece of chewing gum in your hair; you just can't pull it off!
RO, take SOP-II and secure our route into the base!
Got it! SOP-II, follow me!
15, hang in there just a little longer!
We need to fire one more round!
No problem!
